citation.authors: Deru LS, Chamberlain CJ, Lance GR, et al.
citation.title: The Effects of Exercise on Appetite-Regulating Hormone Concentrations over a 36-h Fast in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Crossover Study

population.description: Eleven men and nine women, healthy; exclusions included metabolic disease, medications altering metabolism, BMI below 18.5 or above 30 kg/m2. Age and BMI are the cumulative (n = 20) values of Table 1. Randomized crossover: all 20 completed both conditions.

protocols.name: fast_36h_only
protocols.description: Standardized meal at minute 0 (the fast starts with it), one meal per person sized to 25% of that person's daily energy need, so 614.8 kcal is the group mean (Results: 614.8 ± 85.2 kcal) at 60% carbohydrate, 15% protein, 25% fat (Methods 2.3.3): carbs 614.8*0.60/4 = 92.22 g, protein 614.8*0.15/4 = 23.055 g, fat 614.8*0.25/9 = 17.078 g. Then a water-only fast to 36 h (2160 min); blood at 12, 24, 36 h (the 0 h draw, taken before the meal in people who had only abstained for at least four hours, is not entered). Sleep: the paper gives no hours, so 23:00 to 07:00 on the assumed clock (minutes 900 to 1380). No exercise.

protocols.name: fast_36h_exercise
protocols.description: Standardized meal at minute 0 (the fast starts with it), one meal per person sized to 25% of that person's daily energy need, so 614.8 kcal is the group mean (Results: 614.8 ± 85.2 kcal) at 60% carbohydrate, 15% protein, 25% fat (Methods 2.3.3): carbs 614.8*0.60/4 = 92.22 g, protein 614.8*0.15/4 = 23.055 g, fat 614.8*0.25/9 = 17.078 g. Then a water-only fast to 36 h (2160 min); blood at 12, 24, 36 h (the 0 h draw, taken before the meal in people who had only abstained for at least four hours, is not entered). Sleep: the paper gives no hours, so 23:00 to 07:00 on the assumed clock (minutes 900 to 1380). Treadmill bout starting 30 min into the fast, after the meal (Methods 2), lasting 51.7 min (Table 1 cumulative Exercise Time), 30 to 81.7 min, entered as 30 to 82 because segments take whole minutes; intensity from the mean 9.14 MET printed in Results (whether measured or computed is not stated): VO2 = 9.14*3.5 = 31.99 mL/kg/min, level = (31.99-3.7)/31.7 = 0.892.
